artifact_review: The Router identified 'texture_anomaly' (haloing) and 'structural_collapse' (neck junction). The SAM mask evidence shows a very clean boundary (0.97 confidence), which contradicts the idea of severe edge bleeding, BUT the visual reality is that individual hair tips dissolve into the background blur rather than terminating sharply. This is a subtle 'melting' artifact typical of generative models struggling with fine linear details against depth-of-field blur. I will adjust the artifact score to reflect this subtle but pervasive issue.
